sources.entry: QSpace - A clean and efficient Multi-view File Manager. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1469774098?platform=mac)

summary.name: QSpace
summary.one_liner: QSpace is a Finder-like multi-pane file manager for macOS that also connects to FTP, SFTP, WebDAV and cloud storage services.
use_cases: replace Finder with a more flexible file browser
browse zip and archive files like folders
manage files on remote FTP or SFTP servers
access OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive from the Mac desktop
connect to SMB, NFS or AFP network shares
manage files in Amazon S3 buckets
summary.what_it_does: QSpace is a file manager for macOS with a Finder-like interface and multi-pane layout. It includes built-in MacZip support so archives can be browsed like ordinary folders. It can connect to FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, Aliyun Drive, SMB, NFS, AFP, Amazon S3 (and S3-compatible) and Aliyun OSS servers. The page describes it as offering more customization and practical features than Finder, but does not list specific features beyond these.
notable: Built-in MacZip support for browsing archives as folders
Connects to many remote protocols and cloud services (FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, SMB, NFS, AFP, S3, OneDrive and more)
Available on the Mac App Store; a Pro version is also offered
caveats: A 'QSpace Pro' download is mentioned, but the page does not state what Pro costs or includes
